notes: Book chapter (InTech, Chapter 3, 'Microporous and Mesoporous Materials') reporting the authors' own experimental work with methods in the first person; not a review, perspective, thesis, patent or abstract, so not_primary not applied. Synthesis and ICP details for Zn-CMK-1, Ni-CMK-1 and Pt-CMK-3 are cited to the authors' 2015 papers [12,13], but the chapter never states that its H2 uptake values were published before, and the TiO2-CMK-3 and V-CMK-3 uptakes carry no such citation, so duplicate_data not applied. The text does not name the uptake method; it is volumetric by the instrument named (Micromeritics ASAP 2050, a manometric analyser), 77 K, 0-10 bar, H2 99.9999%. Table 3 gives 10 bar/77 K values for CMK-1 (2.1 wt%), Zn-CMK-1 (4.4), Ni-CMK-1 (2.4); CMK-3, Pt-CMK-3, V-CMK-3 and TiO2-CMK-3 uptakes are in Figure 25 only. All measured sorbents are templated carbons or metal-/metal-oxide-decorated templated carbons with metal loadings of about 1-5.5 wt%, so carbon is the majority component. Surface areas: Table 3 (CMK-1, Zn-CMK-1, Ni-CMK-1, method unnamed, N2 at 77 K) and Table 4 (BET, CMK-3 and its modified samples).
